verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a deployment platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a first-party bulk or batch feature, such as acting on many deployments, projects, domains, or environment variables in one operation. The REST API, CLI automation, and MCP tools are building blocks a user could script bulk actions with, not a bulk-operations capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
